name: meta
sql: CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: jobs
sql: CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,ordinal INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,job_json TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,result_path TEXT,last_error TEXT)

name: attempts
sql: CREATE TABLE attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,job_id TEXT NOT NULL,pid INTEGER,start_ticks INTEGER,boot_id TEXT,pgid INTEGER,status TEXT NOT NULL,lease_cpu REAL NOT NULL,observed_cpu REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,verified_actual_cpu REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,charged_cpu REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,uncertain_upper_cpu REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,final_source TEXT,started_utc TEXT,ended_utc TEXT,exit_code INTEGER,exit_signal INTEGER,out_dir TEXT,attempt_dir TEXT,heartbeat_path TEXT,last_heartbeat_utc TEXT)

name: events
sql: CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,utc TEXT NOT NULL,event TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL)
